name: @juli-os/baton
description: juli-os foundation: terminal remote control — tmux/herdr dual-backend session driving (create/send/capture/kill), PTY attach, and an orthogonal backend factory. Zero npm dependencies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild bin/baton.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/baton.js && chmod +x dist/baton.js && python3 scripts/postbuild.py
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { const c = m.createTmuxClient({}); if (typeof c.listSessions !== 'function' || typeof c.capturePane !== 'function') process.exit(1); const bin = m.resolveTmuxBin(); if (typeof bin !== 'string' || bin === '') process.exit(1); console.log('DIST SMOKE OK'); })"
